source.basis: Each of the four enclosed footprints independently read from its own page 3 vector wall faces; centreline axes are face-pair means rounded to 0.01 PDF pt. Context tracing precision is approximately 0.05 m where wall plaster creates small offsets. Not an as-built survey.

notes: Apartment 4 detailed public/house/house-plan.pdf remains the authoritative unit-4 interior; use this page-3 perimeter only as its building registration/context.
Open service courtyards are outside all four enclosed footprints, even though they have screen/divider walls. Do not extend the enclosed footprint to the end of those screens.
The gross plot polygons contain each unit plus its garden; gardenSurfaceBoundaryWallCentreline is the separate garden shape. Fence centreline is used throughout.
No independent external plot gate is confirmed by the page-3 drawing. Do not invent one.
Page-top and page-bottom identify drawing positions, not geographic north and south.
Core feature rectangles are context extents; exact stair treads, door jambs and lift equipment should continue to use source plans.
Exterior photographs confirm recessed access, fenced garden margins, cream stone finish, and a separate utility-courtyard door; photos provide no metric footprint correction.
